dispositions.result: Action IDs are allocated against the complete current axis, repeated semantic actions remain legal, the last legal frontier survives a dead end, and an entirely unsolvable search returns machine-axis-search-no-solution instead of an empty successful report.

Search state is reconstructed at the actual prefix node frame and includes remaining horizon, resource/effect/cooldown state, pending delayed settlements, and cumulative gain. Action-end, cooldown-ready, resource/state/hit, verified input-window, burst-window, and horizon boundaries now produce bounded wait candidates consumed by the main loop.
The requested burstWindowMs drives canonical metrics, score, ranking, and report output through one projection.
Explicit teamCandidates are normalized outside the inner search, independently simulated, and merged into one global Top-N with per-team failures retained.
Search uses the M12-A critical state-effect guard, accepts explicit seed sets, performs one canonical sample per seed, and ranks on averaged metrics while retaining each sample trace/hash.
